cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：不寻常的
cards.example_en: An unusual bird landed on our balcony this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，一只少见的鸟落在我们的阳台上。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: Our class activity this weekend was a park clean-up.
cards.example_zh: 这个周末，我们班的活动是打扫公园。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：收集；接（人）
cards.example_en: I'll collect you from the station.

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: This collection of ghost stories is the favourite book in our class.
cards.example_zh: 这本鬼故事合集是我们班最喜欢的书。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: We create a short play for the school festival.
cards.example_zh: 我们为学校的节日创作一个短剧。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：国际的
cards.example_en: An international student joined our class this term.
cards.example_zh: 这学期有一位国际学生加入了我们班。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: She took a photograph of the sunset.
cards.example_zh: 她拍了一张日落的照片。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：感兴趣的
cards.example_en: Lucy is interested in joining the school choir.
cards.example_zh: 露西对加入学校合唱团很感兴趣。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: Her drawing of the old bridge hangs in the school entrance.
cards.example_zh: 她的那幅旧桥图画挂在学校入口处。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：令人为难的
cards.example_en: Tripping on the stage was embarrassing, but she kept singing.
cards.example_zh: 在台上绊倒很尴尬，但她继续唱了下去。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：制造业
cards.example_en: Toy manufacturing employs hundreds of people in this town.
cards.example_zh: 玩具制造业雇用了这座镇上的几百人。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：持续进行的
cards.example_en: The ongoing repair of the bridge slows the morning traffic.
cards.example_zh: 大桥正在持续维修，早高峰的交通变慢了。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: His painting of our street hangs in the town library.
cards.example_zh: 他画我们这条街的那幅画挂在镇图书馆里。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.example_en: Slow thinking saved him from a careless mistake.
cards.example_zh: 慢慢思考让他避免了一个粗心的错误。

cards.scene: 兴趣爱好 · Hobbies and Leisure
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：人造的
cards.example_en: These artificial flowers do not need water or sunlight.
cards.example_zh: 这些人造花不需要水和阳光。
